title: Bent-function counts at a fixed linearity index
summary: Determine cardinality bounds for bent functions in n+2 variables after fixing the linearity index, with special attention to those outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class.

formal_statement.body: For every even $n\ge 6$ and every admissible $r$ with $1\le r\le (n+2)/2$, let $C_{n,r}=|\{f\in\mathcal B_{n+2}:\operatorname{ind}(f)=r\}|$. Determine nontrivial valid upper and lower bounds, ideally exact formulas, for $C_{n,r}$; in particular resolve the contribution from $f\notin\mathcal M^{\#}$ that Article 044 identifies as the desired refined count.

scope.domain: Cardinality stratification of bent Boolean functions by linearity index
assumptions: $n$ is even and at least 6, so the source bent-function dimensions are even
$\operatorname{ind}(f)$ is the maximum dimension of an M-subspace of $f$
$\mathcal B_{n+2}$ denotes all bent Boolean functions in $n+2$ variables
The source specifically motivates the outside-$\mathcal M^{\#}$ subcount as the refined target
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work supplies nontrivial bounds for every admissible $n$ and fixed $r$, either for the unrestricted count $C_{n,r}$ or for the source's outside-$\mathcal M^{\#}$ refinement. Existing results count construction classes or exhibit isolated indices, which do not determine this stratified cardinality.

progress.summary: The conclusion asks for bounds on the number of bent functions in n+2 variables with a fixed linearity index to refine the outside-class count.
